scores.evidence: Phase 1: "Unlocks: any outside user. Depends on: V0." Phase 2 "Depends on: V1 before any outside exposure"
scores.rationale: Explicit dependency map and phases each depend on validated predecessors, going from substrate through defenses, retrieval, model access, rollout, feedback.

scores.evidence: "widget on a help-center page behind a feature flag → API service → retrieval over about 20 ingested public articles in pgvector → hosted LLM → answer with citations"
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end deployed slice with CI/CD, rollback and V0 exit check.

scores.evidence: "Legal rejects the terms → self-hosted open-weight model behind the same interface"
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions have reversibility class, default, assumption, validation and flip condition; R1 defaults and N/A items are also listed.

scores.evidence: "Phase 1: Defenses and budgets ... Injection suite in CI ... Output filter ... PII redaction"
scores.rationale: Phase-level ordering is broad-to-narrow, but within-phase task lists are not explicitly ordered by blast radius.

scores.evidence: "Phase 0 | SSO allow-list, secrets in a vault, token caps"
scores.rationale: Concrete security measures appear in every phase 0–5 in the cross-cutting table and in phase tasks.

scores.evidence: "Each request gets an OpenTelemetry trace with retrieved chunk IDs, tokens, cost and latency."
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every later phase.

scores.evidence: "Infrastructure as code; model, prompt and embedding versions pinned"
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely per phase: pinned versions, versioned index and eval set, config in repo, rollout config.

scores.evidence: "Flag rollback, timeouts" (Phase 0); "Fallback model, retries" (Phase 3); "Kill switch, staged rollout percentages"
scores.rationale: Failure handling is present in every phase, starting with Phase 0.

scores.evidence: "Phase 1: Defenses and budgets" before "Phase 2: Retrieval", then "Phase 3: Model access and session memory", routing deferred, Phase 5 Feedback
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human-in-the-loop precede retrieval, then model access, memory, orchestration, routing (deferred), feedback, in correct order.

scores.evidence: "Account actions (order lookup, refunds): comes forward if more than 20% of handoffs need account data."
scores.rationale: Deferred items are explicit, each with a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong, well-ordered plan with only within-phase blast-radius ordering left implicit.
